The bowl is a stainless steel mixing bowl, probably about 25-30 cm across at the rim. It fills most of the frame, at roughly 500 px wide. The chicken pieces cover a patch of about 200 px, which is roughly 10-12 cm, and sit one or two pieces deep.

There are about 40 cubes, each about 2 cm across and weighing around 4-5 g. That comes to roughly 150-180 g, so I'll use 160 g.

The chicken looks like cooked breast, which is about 165 kcal per 100 g.
